info.title: Event authorization context — D09/F05 DRAFT
info.description: P8 proposal only, not accepted or implemented. Provider: Event; consumer: Identity EventContextResolver. Returns authoritative event/organization metadata including DRAFT events. Does not authorize the end user. Internal trusted local network only; deployment beyond local requires a separately approved service authentication scheme. No public Gateway route. Changes require Event/Identity owner review before M4 implementation.

x-approval: Required before provider/adapter implementation; no consumer acceptance recorded
x-compatibility: Additive proposed internal API; Identity HTTP v1.2.0 and accepted P5 resolver interface unchanged. Breaking draft revisions require review and regeneration before adoption.

get.description: Read from Event-owned storage without calling Identity authorization/check. All existing DRAFT/PUBLISHED/CANCELLED events resolve; lifecycle eligibility is not asserted. No request body, idempotency key, end-user bearer token or client-supplied organization. Caller validates response UUIDs and requested event ID, compares organization, then rechecks current local authorization under Identity transaction locks. No cache, cross-database read, fixture fallback or distributed transaction.
get.x-trust-boundary: Local internal network; security:[] does not authorize public exposure. Non-local service authentication remains undecided.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: One UUID propagated for correlation, otherwise generate a UUID; never identity evidence.

200.description: Existing event, including DRAFT. Both UUIDs required and non-null; event_id equals requested eventId. Organization is owned by Event, never copied from caller input.

existingDraftEvent.summary: Synthetic DRAFT event metadata; no status field is transmitted

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no existing event; tombstone/delete policy remains open

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: caller fails closed, maps to upstream unavailable
